# hg validate

**What this page tells you:** every `hg validate` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

The contract gate, no cluster: every failure at once.

## Synopsis

```text
hg validate [flags]
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## Flags

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dir` | `<repo-path-or-git-url>` | — | The persona/distribution repository to read declarations from. |

## Examples

```bash
hg validate
hg validate --dir ../my-team --json
```
